_comment: Canonical description of the Pilot plan file format. Edit THIS file, never a generated copy.
Known DUPLICATE readers, deliberately NOT wired to this file. They predate it and
re-derive the same facts with their own regexes; rewiring them is a refactor with no
user-visible effect and a real regression surface on the statusline:
- launcher/statusline/formatter.py  (progress counts, header fields, phase derivation)
If you change a rule here, check whether those three still agree.
OUT OF SCOPE, deliberately: pilot/hooks/native_plan_capture.py files a plan approved in the
agent's own plan mode into docs/plans/ with `Status: SAVED` and `Type: Plan` - values this
schema does NOT allow, because that document is not a workflow run and `pilot spec validate`
should keep rejecting it as a spec. The Console parses both values (planFileReader.ts,
specType.ts) so a captured plan renders and stays out of the active-run surfaces. Widening the
allowed lists below to accept them would weaken validation for real /spec plans.
_line_ending_comment: The Console parser splits on \n and anchors its task regexes with $. A CRLF plan captures \r into every task title and loses its task cards, so CRLF is a validator ERROR, not a tolerated input.
_sections_ordered_comment: Render order for recognised sections on both surfaces. A heading NOT listed here is no longer dropped -- it renders after these, in document order. 'Global Constraints', 'File Structure' and 'Changed Files' were previously absent and therefore silently hidden.
_sections_hidden_comment: Never rendered as a section. Progress Tracking is already shown by each surface's header card as a task count; 'Progress' is the legacy heading for the same checklist and is hidden for the same reason.
_progress_sections_comment: The heading whose top-level Task N checklist drives progress for each plan type. Bugfix plans intentionally keep the checklist and task bodies together under Tasks; they do not duplicate it in Progress Tracking.
_tasks_headings_comment: Rendered by a dedicated task-card component, not as an ordinary section. 'Implementation Tasks' is feature/build, 'Tasks' is bugfix.
_pattern_cr_comment: Titles use [^\r\n]+ rather than .+ on purpose: `.` matches \r, so a CRLF plan would parse as valid with \r captured into every title -- silently accepting what the Console renders wrong. Rejecting the line here is defense-in-depth behind the validator's whole-file CRLF check.
_progress_line_comment: A Buildout's `## Acceptance Criteria` uses Criterion N; its `## Progress Tracking` still uses Task N.
_task_field_labels_comment: Verbatim bold labels a task body must contain for the Console to render its fields as separate collapsible blocks. Plain 'Files:' or 'DoD:' does not render.
_task_optional_fields_comment: Owner is omitted for ordinary agent tasks. User-owned tasks are supported by Feature and Bugfix plans only and require a concrete User Action; Buildouts remain autonomous.
